name: Integration - LLM Provider Selection and Initialization
description: Verifies that the agent initializes the correct LLM client based on the LLM_PROVIDER environment variable.
input: Set LLM_PROVIDER to 'openai' and provide a valid OPENAI_API_KEY in environment variables.
output: Agent initializes an AsyncOpenAI client instance.
success_criteria: llm_client is an instance of AsyncOpenAI
No exception is raised during initialization
error_scenarios: ValueError is raised for supported provider
